redCandidate.setup: Package the current v5.0.3 checkout into a temporary release directory and inspect the generated Unix archive.

args: set -e; receipt_out=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf $receipt_out" EXIT; bash scripts/package-release.sh --out "$receipt_out" >/dev/null; tar -tzf "$receipt_out/harness-cli.tar.gz" | rg -q "harness-cli/packages/debug-hub/dist/cli.js"

redCandidate.expected: The release archive contains the runnable bundled debug-hub MCP entrypoint at packages/debug-hub/dist/cli.js.
redCandidate.observed: The packaging command exited with code 1 because the archive did not contain packages/debug-hub/dist/cli.js.
redCandidate.failureReason: The release path list excludes packages/debug-hub and the source checkout has no tracked compiled dist output.
